title: 第16章 适应第17章 报复一
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
院外天色渐暗。
主厅内，上方水晶灯撒下一圈柔和暖黄光。
将对面胡昭的面容衬托的愈发柔和。
看着这一幕，薛雾眼中闪过一丝痴迷。
抬手推了推镜架，将一份文件轻轻推至对方面前。
“这次合同细则在这里，你看一看，这可是我好不容易谈下来的。”
他顿了顿，视线落在胡昭低垂的眼睫上，声音里添了几分期待。
“另外……我听说东城区新开了家西餐，口碑很好，小昭，今晚要不要一起去尝尝？”
胡昭的目光从纸张间抬起，看了他一眼。
随即，她摇了摇头，神色未有任何的波澜。
“不用了，今晚我要在家吃。”
她的声音平静。
“还有，眼下正是公司最关键的时候，你我的心思，还是该全然放在正事上。”
她合上文件，抬眼直视着他。
“别忘了你答应我爸的事。
等你真正做出一番事业，我们才有往后可言，也只有到那时，你才会得到他的认可，也才算是我的老公。”
薛雾微微一怔，面上闪过一丝肉眼可见的无奈与失望。
沉默了一下，他才低声道：“好吧，那就改日再说。”
“我还有点事，先离开了，要是有什么事情，记得发信息给我。”
“嗯，开车慢点！”

胡昭点了点头，嘱咐了一句。
见到胡昭没有挽留，薛雾轻叹一声，转身离去。
看着对方离开的身影。
胡昭眉头微蹙.
对于薛雾的想法，她不是看不出来。
可惜，受到家庭的影响，在真正结婚之前。
她并不愿意过多的与其亲密接触，就算是对方是她名义上的男友也同样如此。
她是一个本性很传统的人。
婚前的亲密接触。
这在她看来是一种不自爱的行为。
想到这里，她摇了摇头。
重新将注意力放在手中的文件上。
……
离开的薛雾乘坐电梯，一路来到车库，坐进自己车内，关上车门。
此刻，地库里空荡寂静，只有他一人。
content_en:
It was getting dark outside the hospital.
In the main hall, the crystal lamp above casts a soft and warm yellow light.
The face of Hu Zhao opposite him became softer and softer.
Looking at this scene, a trace of obsession flashed in Xue Wu's eyes.
He raised his hand and pushed the frame of the glasses, then gently pushed a document in front of the other party.
"The details of this contract are here. Take a look. I finally negotiated this."
He paused, his eyes falling on Hu Zhao's lowered eyelashes, and his voice added a bit of expectation.
"Also...I heard that a new Western restaurant has opened in Dongcheng District. It has a good reputation. Xiao Zhao, do you want to go and try it tonight?"
Hu Zhao raised his eyes from the papers and glanced at him.
Immediately, she shook her head, her expression unchanged.
"No, I want to eat at home tonight."
Her voice was calm.
"Also, right now is the most critical time for the company. You and I should all focus on business."
She closed the file and looked directly at him.
“Don’t forget what you promised my dad.
Only when you truly accomplish something will we have a future to talk about, and only then will you be recognized by him and be considered my husband. "
Xue Wu was slightly startled, a trace of helplessness and disappointment visible to the naked eye flashed across his face.
After a moment of silence, he whispered: "Okay, let's talk about it another day."
"I have something else to do, so I'm leaving first. If anything happens, remember to send me a message."
"Well, drive slower!"
Hu Zhao nodded and gave instructions.
Seeing that Hu Zhao did not stay, Xue Wu sighed softly, turned around and left.
Watching the other party leave.
Hu Zhao frowned slightly.
It's not that she can't see Xue Wu's thoughts.
Unfortunately, due to the influence of the family, before actually getting married.
She is not willing to have too much intimate contact with him, even if the other person is her nominal boyfriend.
She is a very traditional person.
Premarital intimacy.
This seemed to her to be a lack of self-love.
Thinking of this, she shook her head.
Return your attention to the document in your hand.
…
After leaving, Xue Wu took the elevator all the way to the garage, got into his car, and closed the door.
At this moment, the basement was empty and silent, and he was the only one.
